correctness.rationale: C: A dominated committee pair has an ordered disjoint equal-cardinality exchange t<=min(k,m-k). For one voter, P[#Y>=#X] = (1+binom(2t,t)/4^t)/2, yielding rho_1=3/4, rho_2=11/16, rho_3=21/32 and decreasing higher-t terms. All-equality probabilities are (binom(2t,t)/4^t)^n. An independent, fully exhaustive 256-row bitmask calculation over all 56 t=1 and 420 t=2 events gave sharp maximal pair overlaps 160/256,160/256,152/256 for (1,1),(1,2),(2,2). Bonferroni and union bounds therefore prove the displayed finite-n error envelopes and the nonlocal conditional law; the five-voter four-column witness (3,5,10,28) demonstrates true two-swap improvement. Finite certificate handles fixed eight-bit overlap only; all n follow from analytic bounds.
